services.desc: Master Sam Wolf has been in the martial arts for over 30 years. He started his martial arts journey in 1981 under Jay T. Will’s in Kempo Karate. Although he did not get serious in the martial arts until he started training under Greg Fears in 1984, at the Police Athletic League, in Columbus Ohio in taekwondo. He currently trains under Grandmaster “Datu” Tim Hartman in Presas Arnis. He has Trained under a few great instructors in various disciplines, including but not limited to Hapkido, Modern & Presas Arnis, Balintawak, Kempo Karate, Aikido, Gumdo, European Sword( Various reconstructions of the ancient masters) , Tai Chi, Ship Pal Gi ( Korean Kung Fu), Praying Mantis Kung fu, Judo, Jeet
